## Summary

Describe the behavior changed and why it belongs in the current scope.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Scope

- [ ] The patch is limited to one coherent change.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed contract or setup step.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, local databases, or generated files are included.
